1283-1651-3129-6441-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Primal Vigor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
1283-1651-3129-6441-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

1545-1981-2415-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1545-1981-2415-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

512-1606-4091.easyPrerequisites: Ley Weaver and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-1606-4091.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.
512-1606-4091.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Ley Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

728-4311-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
728-4311-4871-5220.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2816-7908.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Halflings.

738-2034-7707-7883.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a nontoken creature.
738-2034-7707-7883.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Super-Adaptoid, adding {C}{C}.
When Super-Adaptoid dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a nontoken creature they control.
When a creature dies this way, Glissa triggers, returning Super-Adaptoid from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Super-Adaptoid by paying {2}.
When Super-Adaptoid enters, it triggers, choosing Glissa and giving Super-Adaptoid deathtouch and first strike.
Repeat as able.
738-2034-7707-7883.notes: You can repeat this lock during each of your turns so long as an opponent controls a nontoken creature.

579-1978-3139-5793.description:
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding four mana due to Mana Reflection and gaining 2 life.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Great Henge which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Great Henge.
Repeat.

4399-4518-5998-6719.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Dazzling Angel trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-5998-6719.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a nonlegendary artifact you control

1167-2047-7692.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating an artifact token.
Activate Shuri by paying {1} and tapping it, causing the artifact token to become a copy of Mindslaver that isn't legendary.
Activate the artifact token by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

147-2921-5188.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2921-5188.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2033-3490-7075-7292.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
2033-3490-7075-7292.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {G}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2921-4605-6132-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.battlefieldCardState: without a finality counter on it

4050-4053-7134--145.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Villain without a finality counter on it.
When the Villain dies, Thunderbolts Conspiracy triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

4681-5170-6634-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2366-4452-6798-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4452-6798-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

567-2034-3490-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-2034-3490-4017.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2615-5342.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a higher life total than Tree of Perdition's toughness.
2615-5342.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, causing its toughness to become equal to an opponents life total, and causing that opponent to lose life equal to twice the difference between their life total and Tree of Perdition's toughness as the ability resolved.
If the opponent's life total was at least double Tree of Perdition's toughness as the ability resolved, they will lose the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.

147-413-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Abnormal Endurance triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-4927-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

3394-3967-6249--5.notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3394-3967-6249--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Weatherlight Compleated trigger.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1170-1171-5140.manaNeeded: {R} if Garth One-Eye has summoning sickness
1170-1171-5140.description:
If Garth One-Eye has summoning sickness, activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving creatures you control trample and haste until end of turn.
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
If you have no {R} available, activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
1170-1171-5140.notes:
Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability or activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

440-1339-4506-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-4506-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

390-5329-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Hulking Metamorph on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Hulking Metamorph do not have summoning sickness.
390-5329-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Hulking Metamorph.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Hulking Metamorph.
Activate Hulking Metamorph by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

5413-5478-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
5413-5478-5720-5721.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

330-4508-4772.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander, and your commander is a Pirate.
You control at least one additional creature or artifact.
330-4508-4772.description:
Activate your commander by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

832-1371-3765-5049.description:
Cast Thoughtseize by paying {B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Thoughtseize.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Worldfire.
Resolve each Worldfire on the stack, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Thoughtseize, causing them to lose 2 life.
The opponent loses the game due to having less than zero life.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining opponent.

719-1219-2348-4438-4499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five lands, plus additional lands that do not have summoning sickness and can tap to produce at least {3}.
"Cleric" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1219-2348-4438-4499.description:
Activate Ancestor's Prophet by tapping five lands you control, causing you to gain 10 life.
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Beledros by paying 10 life, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Beledros.
Repeat.
If the additional lands can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

3263-3698-3764.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
The Pincher enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, triggering Grinding Station, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

760-779-1209-1272-5229.notablePrerequisites: At least one additional land in graveyard or library.
760-779-1209-1272-5229.description:
Activate Seismic Assault by discarding Dakmor Salvage, targeting Swans of Bryn Argoll.
When Swans of Bryn Argoll would be dealt damage, it replaces that damage with 2 card draws.
Replace one of the draws with Dakmor Salvage's dredge 2 ability.
Repeat until you have either 1 or 0 cards in your library, holding priority on anything that might trigger and continuing the loop.
Activate Seismic Assault discarding all lands with the exception of Dakmor Salvage targeting your opponent, then based on if you milled Ulamog, Kozilek, or both, follow the instructions below.
If you milled both Ulamog and Kozilek, resolve the most recent trigger, then repeat from the beginning.
If you milled Kozilek and drew Ulamog or vice versa, resolve the shuffle trigger then repeat from the beginning.
If you drew both Ulamog and Kozilek.
resolve any shuffle triggers left on the stack, then move to the cleanup phase and discard both titans to handsize.
Resolve one of the shuffle triggers, then repeat from the beginning in response to the other shuffle trigger.
